what: Comfort Systems USA installs and services the mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems inside buildings: heating and air conditioning, piping, electrical and fire protection. Data centres and chip plants have become its largest and fastest-growing market.
customers: Data centre developers, semiconductor and pharmaceutical plant builders, hospitals, schools, and commercial and industrial property owners.
money: HVAC, plumbing, piping, controls and off-site modular construction
moat: Skilled trade labour at scale, which is the binding constraint on data centre construction, plus modular prefabrication that lets it build faster than rivals.
risks: Data centre construction is now a large share of its backlog, so a pause there would hurt
Skilled labour shortages limit how fast it can grow
The shares have risen a long way and trade at a high multiple
opportunities: Revenue grew about 30% last year and about 30% a year over three years
Return on invested capital of 35% with cash of $2.2 billion against almost no debt
Analysts see large upside, with a median target well above the current price
watch: The backlog and same-store revenue growth.
